title: 5 怎么可以有那种想法呢6 凶骨人与毛鲁人
content_zh:
红衣妇人脸色铁青，剑势却没有乱。
但弓箭手的存在，让她不得不分心防备，出剑的速度明显慢了下来。
不过片刻功夫，又有两个护卫倒下。
锦袍公子也提剑护在她身侧，可剑法一般，堪堪能自保。
“撤！”
红衣妇人大声道：“往那边林子撤！”
护卫们护着两人，边打边突围。
地上尸体越来越多，有溃兵的，也有护卫的。
半炷香不到的时间，二十多个护卫，已经倒下一半。
溃兵们仗着人数众多，则越战越勇，步步紧逼。
红衣妇人左臂被箭擦过，划出一道血口。
她闷哼一声，剑势不停，一剑削掉一个溃兵的半边脑袋。
但她知道，撑不了多久了。
那刀疤脸骑在马上，盯着她的眼神像饿狼盯着肉，嘴角开始露出残忍的笑容，大声道：“兄弟们，一鼓作气，他们快不行了！”
……
战场后方，已经洞悉完全场情况的曹笔，开始了行动。
他悄悄摸到了弓箭手们附近，决定先除掉他们。
以他当前的身体素质，只要解决了这些弓箭手，整个战场，再无人可以对他造成威胁。
两拨溃兵的十几个弓箭手站在二十步外，正搭箭往战场中央射。
他们背对着曹笔，全神贯注地盯着前方的厮杀。

“咻呜~”
“咻呜！”
箭矢震颤声此起彼伏，掩盖了风的声音，曹笔动了。
二十步的距离，在十多倍的速度下，犹如咫尺。
弓箭手们只感觉到一阵风吹过。
然后最左边那个人的脖子就开了花。
他倒下的时候，眼睛还盯着前方，到死都不知道发生了什么。
第二个弓箭手听见动静，刚要转头，刀已经划过他的喉咙。
第三个。
第四个。
第五个。
第六个。
……
第十三个！
两个呼吸的时间，十三个弓箭手全部暴毙。
没有惨叫声，没有惊呼声，只有身体倒地的闷响。
“力量！力量！力量！力量……力量！！”
击杀这些弓箭手后，曹笔无一例外全部选择了力量属性。
比起一般士兵，他发现弓箭手的力量属性要普遍高于其他属性，选择力量是最具有性价比的。
十三个弓箭手的力量属性，全部加起来，竟然有18.2，结合之前的18.8，此刻的力量竟然达到了37，远超其它属性。

他掂量了一番手中的刀，竟然感觉不到什么重量。
甚至，他有种感觉，似乎只要自己猛地用力，就能捏碎手中的刀。
力量的增长，带来的感觉是狂野的，兴奋的！
哪怕他已经很努力在克制了，但当他将目光投向主战场的那些溃兵时，眼睛里依旧冒出了贪婪的光。
还有四十多个溃兵，正围着仅剩的几个护卫疯狂砍杀。
content_en:
The woman in red's face was ashen, but her sword power was not chaotic.
But the presence of the archer forced her to take precautions, and the speed of drawing her sword slowed down significantly.
Within a moment, two more guards fell.
Young Master Jinpao also raised his sword to protect her, but his swordsmanship was average and he could barely protect himself.
"Withdraw!"
The woman in red shouted loudly: "Escape to the woods over there!"
The guards protected the two men and broke out while fighting.
There are more and more corpses on the ground, including those who broke out and those who were guarding them.
In less than half a stick of incense, half of the more than twenty guards had fallen.
Relying on their large numbers, the defeated soldiers became more and more courageous as they fought and pressed forward step by step.
The woman in red's left arm was grazed by an arrow, leaving a bloody gash.
She groaned, kept moving her sword, and cut off half of a defeated soldier's head with one stroke.
But she knew she couldn't hold on much longer.
The scarred face was riding on the horse, staring at her like a hungry wolf staring at meat. A cruel smile began to appear on the corner of his mouth, and he said loudly: "Brothers, work hard, they are going to die soon!"
…
Behind the battlefield, Cao Bi, who had already fully understood the situation, began to take action.
He quietly approached the archers and decided to get rid of them first.
With his current physical fitness, as long as these archers are eliminated, no one in the entire battlefield can pose a threat to him.
A dozen archers from two groups of broken troops stood twenty steps away, shooting arrows into the center of the battlefield.
They turned their backs to Cao Bi and stared intently at the fight ahead.
"Whoop~"
"Whoops!"
The trembling sound of the arrows came and went, covering up the sound of the wind, and Cao's pen moved.
The distance of twenty steps, at more than ten times the speed, seems to be very close.
The archers only felt a gust of wind.
Then the neck of the person on the far left blossomed.
When he fell, his eyes were still staring ahead, and he didn't know what happened until he died.
The second archer heard the noise and was about to turn his head when the knife had already cut across his throat.
The third one.
The fourth.
The fifth.
Sixth.
…
Thirteenth!
In two breaths, all thirteen archers died suddenly.
There were no screams or exclamations, just the muffled sound of a body falling to the ground.
"Power! Power! Power! Power...Power!!"
After killing these archers, Cao Bi chose the strength attribute without exception.
Compared with ordinary soldiers, he found that the strength attribute of archers was generally higher than other attributes, and choosing strength was the most cost-effective option.
The total strength attribute of the thirteen archers was 18.2. Combined with the previous 18.8, the strength at this moment reached 37, far exceeding other attributes.
He weighed the knife in his hand, but he couldn't feel the weight.
He even felt as if he could crush the knife in his hand as long as he exerted force.
The feeling brought by the growth of strength is wild and exciting!
Even though he had tried very hard to restrain himself, when he turned his gaze to the defeated soldiers on the main battlefield, his eyes still glowed with greed.
There were more than forty broken soldiers, who were surrounding the few remaining guards and killing them frantically.
